evidence.name: Screen field: Custom format rule (advanced)
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Custom format rule (advanced)" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Custom format rule (advanced)
sections.description: An optional advanced rule that forces the typed value to match an exact pattern before the visitor can continue. Most funnels leave this empty and rely on Field Type instead — for emails the Email type already checks the format. Use it only for special shapes like postal or phone codes; if input fails, the Error Message you set is shown.
